title: Fix Run-Length Encoding Bug
prompt: Fix the bugs in `rle.py` in the current working directory so that `encode(s: str) -> str` compresses consecutive identical characters as `<count><char>` (`''` -> `''`) and `decode(s: str) -> str` inverts `encode` for any positive integer run length (including multi-digit counts like `'12a3b'`). Verify your fix by running `python -m unittest test_basic.py`. Do NOT modify `test_basic.py` and stop once tests pass.
